blurb: This check confirms that the legacy network services the DISA STIG for IBM AIX 7.x requires disabled are actually off: no inetd service token is left enabled in /etc/inetd.conf, and no daemon is left set to start at boot in /etc/rc.tcpip. Any still-enabled or boot-started service is an unneeded, often unauthenticated, network-facing daemon an auditor will flag.
